## MedplumClientOptions.fhirUrlPath property

FHIR URL path.

Default value is `fhir/R4/`<!-- -->.

Can be specified as absolute URL or relative to baseUrl.

Use this if you want to use a different path when connecting to a FHIR server.

**Signature:**

```typescript
fhirUrlPath?: string;
```
